ask.description: Tokens a holder offers for sale at a price. Written only by the token marketplace transitions: the listed tokens are held in escrow under the order's id until it is filled or cancelled.

tokenId.description: The token the order is for

price.description: The credits the seller asks per whole token (10 to the power of the order's decimals base units)

amount.description: The token amount, in base units, listed when the order was placed

remaining.description: The token amount, in base units, still open. The order is deleted when it is filled entirely

minFill.description: The smallest amount, in base units, a fill may take, unless it takes everything still open. A fill may not leave less than this open either

expiresAt.description: The block time, in milliseconds, from which the order can no longer be filled. It can still be cancelled

decimals.description: The token's decimals when the order was placed: the price is per 10 to the power of this many base units for the life of the order, even if the token's decimals change later

bid.description: An offer to buy a token at a price. Written only by the token marketplace transitions: the offered credits are held in escrow under the order's id until it is filled or cancelled.

tokenId.description: The token the order is for

price.description: The credits the buyer pays per whole token (10 to the power of the order's decimals base units)

amount.description: The token amount, in base units, wanted when the order was placed

remaining.description: The token amount, in base units, still open. The order is deleted when it is filled entirely

minFill.description: The smallest amount, in base units, a fill may take, unless it takes everything still open. A fill may not leave less than this open either

expiresAt.description: The block time, in milliseconds, from which the order can no longer be filled. It can still be cancelled

escrow.description: The credits still held in escrow for the order. They cover what the open amount costs at the order's price; what is left once it is filled goes back to the buyer

decimals.description: The token's decimals when the order was placed: the price is per 10 to the power of this many base units for the life of the order, even if the token's decimals change later
